Terms of Service
These Terms of Service govern your use of the Tanot Solutions website and the professional SEO and link building services we provide. By engaging with us — whether through our website, a strategy call, or a formal service agreement — you agree to these terms. Please read them carefully before using our website or services. If you have any questions or need clarification, you can email us at info@tanotsolutions.com.
1. About Tanot Solutions

Tanot Solutions is a global SEO and link building agency. Founded in 2020, we specialize in high-authority, white-hat link building, technical SEO, AI SEO, local SEO, and content strategy for B2B brands, SaaS companies, agencies, and e-commerce businesses worldwide.

These Terms of Service apply to:

Your use of our website at tanotsolutions.com
Any services you engage us to provide, including but not limited to link building, technical SEO, on-page SEO, AI SEO, local SEO, content strategy, white-label SEO services, and related digital marketing support
All communications between you and our team related to our services
2. Our Services
2.1 What we offer

Tanot Solutions provides professional SEO and link-building services, tailored to each client's goals and requirements.

Our services may include, but are not limited to:

Link Building
Technical SEO
AI SEO
Local SEO
SaaS SEO
On-Page and Content SEO
White-Label Link Building

The specific scope, deliverables, timelines, pricing, and service expectations for each engagement will be confirmed before work begins and may be documented in a separate proposal or service agreement.

In the event of any conflict between these Terms of Service and a separate signed agreement, the signed agreement shall take precedence.

2.2 White-hat approach

Tanot Solutions follows editorial-first, white-hat link-building practices designed to align with Google's Webmaster Guidelines and long-term SEO best practices. We do not use private blog networks (PBNs), link farms, automated link schemes, spammy backlink tactics, or other manipulative practices that may create unnecessary risk for your website.

While search engine policies and algorithm interpretations may evolve over time, our approach is focused on sustainable, quality-driven SEO strategies intended to support long-term organic growth and brand authority.

3. How Our Engagement Works
3.1 No lock-in contracts

We do not require long-term lock-in contracts for our services. Unless otherwise agreed in writing, you may cancel at any time by providing 30 days' written notice.

3.2 No upfront payment

For link building services, we operate on a pay-per-link model. You are invoiced only for links that are live and verified at the end of each month. Unless otherwise agreed in writing, there are no upfront fees for link placements or initial strategy consultation.

3.3 Site approval

Before any link is placed, we share a list of target websites for your review and approval. No link will be placed on a website that has not been approved by you. This approval process is a core part of our service methodology and helps ensure brand alignment, relevance, and quality control.

3.4 Link replacement guarantee

If a link we have placed is removed within 12 months of going live due to publisher removal or other organic circumstances beyond your control, we will make reasonable efforts to replace it at no additional cost. This guarantee does not apply to links removed at your request, due to changes made by you or your team, website migrations, redirects, or actions that affect the original placement.

3.5 Reporting

We provide clear, transparent reporting for all active campaigns. Reports may include live URLs, anchor text, placement status, and relevant traffic and ranking data where applicable. Reports are typically delivered at the end of each month or as otherwise agreed in writing.

4. Client Responsibilities

To allow us to deliver services effectively, you agree to:

Provide accurate information about your website, business, and SEO goals during onboarding and throughout the engagement
Respond to site approval requests, content review, and campaign updates in a timely manner (we recommend within 3–5 business days) to avoid delays in delivery
Ensure that the website(s) we are building links to are owned by you, your client, or that you have proper authorization to manage SEO for and make decisions on their behalf
Not engage simultaneously with other link building providers using black-hat, manipulative tactics, or policy-violating tactics for the same domain, where such actions may negatively affect campaign performance or create unnecessary SEO risk
Notify us promptly of any changes to your website, domain, or business strategy that may affect the campaign planning or results

Failure to meet these responsibilities may impact campaign timelines, performance, and deliverables, and Tanot Solutions shall not be held responsible for delays or reduced results arising from such circumstances.

5. Payments And Invoicing
5.1 Payment terms

Invoices are issued at the end of each month for links that went live during that billing period, unless otherwise agreed in writing. Payment is due within 14 days of the invoice date unless otherwise agreed in writing.

5.2 Late payments

If payment is not received within 14 days of the invoice due date, we reserve the right to pause active work, delay deliverables, or suspend ongoing campaign activity until the outstanding balance is fully settled. We will make reasonable efforts to notify you before pausing or suspending services.

5.3 Disputes

If you believe an invoice is incorrect, you must notify us within 7 days of receipt by emailing at info@tanotsolutions.com. We will review the matter and respond promptly. Undisputed portions of an invoice remain payable within the original payment terms.

5.4 Taxes

All fees and prices are exclusive of applicable taxes, including but not limited to GST, VAT, or similar taxes, unless expressly stated otherwise. Clients are responsible for any taxes, duties, or charges applicable in their jurisdiction in connection with our services.

5.5 Refunds

Because our services involve manual outreach, publisher negotiations, strategic work, and live link placements, fees paid for completed work and verified live links are non-refundable.

If there is a genuine service issue, we encourage clients to contact us so we can review the matter fairly and work toward a reasonable resolution.

6. Cancellation

Either party may terminate the engagement with 30 days' written notice sent to info@tanotsolutions.com. You will be invoiced for any links placed, verified, and approved during the notice period. Any work already in progress at the time of cancellation notice will be completed and invoiced unless you direct us otherwise.

We reserve the right to pause or terminate an engagement immediately if a client:

breaches these Terms of Service
provides false, misleading, or incomplete information
fails to make payments within the agreed timeframes
engages in abusive, unlawful, or inappropriate conduct toward our team
requests services or actions that conflict with our ethical standards or compliance policies

Termination of services does not remove the obligation to pay any outstanding invoices for completed work.

7. Results And No Guarantee Of Rankings

SEO results depend on many factors outside our reasonable control, including search engine algorithm changes, competitor activity, website health, technical issues, content quality, and third-party publisher decisions. While we apply proven strategies and maintain a strong track record of delivering quality results, Tanot Solutions does not guarantee specific rankings, traffic levels, lead generation, revenue outcomes, or search engine placement.

Any timelines discussed during strategy calls, proposals, or campaign planning are estimates only and should not be interpreted as guarantees of performance.

We guarantee quality, transparency, and a process built around your long-term SEO growth. SEO is a long-term investment and results may vary from client to client. Most clients begin seeing meaningful improvements within 3–6 months.

8. Intellectual Property
8.1 Our content

All content on tanotsolutions.com — including blog posts, case studies, service descriptions, methodology documentation, and reports — is the intellectual property of Tanot Solutions. You may not reproduce, republish, distribute, modify, or commercially use our content without our prior written permission.

8.2 Deliverables

Upon full payment of all applicable invoices, you retain the benefit of the backlinks, content placements, and agreed deliverables secured for your website as part of our services. However, reports, strategies, and proprietary processes developed or used by Tanot Solutions remain our intellectual property and may not be copied, resold, or reused without written permission.

We do not claim ownership over third-party publisher websites or platforms where placements are secured.

8.3 Your content

When you provide us with content, brand materials, or access to your website for the purposes of delivering services, you confirm that you have the legal right to provide and authorize the use of those materials.

You grant Tanot Solutions a limited, non-exclusive licence to use those materials solely to deliver the agreed services during the term of the engagement.

9. Confidentiality

Both parties agree to keep confidential any non-public information shared during the course of the engagement, including client strategy, pricing, campaign data, access credentials, and internal business information. This confidential obligation applies during the ongoing engagement and will continue for three years after the engagement ends, unless a longer period is required by law or agreed separately in writing.

Tanot Solutions may reference your company name and results in case studies, testimonials, or marketing materials only with your explicit written consent. If you prefer to remain anonymous (as some clients do), we will honour that in all promotional or public-facing content.

10. Limitation Of Liability

To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, Tanot Solutions shall not be liable for:

Any loss of revenue, profits, or business opportunities arising from the use of our services
Any changes to search engine algorithms, platform policies, publisher decisions, or third-party actions that affect your website's rankings, traffic, or performance
Any actions taken by third-party publishers, platforms, or tools outside our reasonable control
Any indirect, incidental, special, or consequential damages, even if we have been advised of the possibility of such damages

Our total liability to you for any direct damages arising from or related to our services shall not exceed the total fees paid by you to Tanot Solutions during the 3 months immediately preceding the event giving rise to the claim.

Nothing in these Terms limits or excludes liability for fraud, willful misconduct, gross negligence, or anything that cannot be excluded under applicable law.

11. Indemnification

You agree to indemnify and hold Tanot Solutions, its founders, team members, and contractors harmless from any claims, losses, damages, liabilities, costs, or expenses (including reasonable legal fees) arising from:

Your breach of these Terms of Service
Your misuse of our services or use of our services in a manner not authorized under these Terms
Any false, misleading, or unlawful information provided by you
Any content, materials, or instructions provided by you that infringe the intellectual property, privacy, or other rights of any third party

This indemnification obligation applies to the fullest extent permitted by applicable law.

12. Use Of Website

By using tanotsolutions.com, you agree not to:

Use the website for any unlawful purpose or in violation of any applicable laws or regulations
Attempt to gain unauthorized access to any part of the website or its infrastructure
Scrape, copy, reproduce, republish, or distribute website content without prior written permission from Tanot Solutions
Submit false or misleading information through our contact forms or other communication channels
Use bots, automated tools, scripts, or other methods to interact with the website in a way that disrupts normal operation, security, or performance of the website
Engage in any activity that may harm the reputation, security, or functionality of Tanot Solutions or its digital assets

We reserve the right to restrict, suspend, or block access to our website or services for anyone who violates these Terms or engages in behavior that we reasonably believe may harm our business, systems, or users.

13. Third-Party Links And Tools

Our website may contain links to third-party platforms, including Clutch, LinkedIn, and publisher websites where we've secured client placements. Links are provided for informational purposes only. Tanot Solutions does not own, control, or endorse the content, services, privacy practices, or terms of use of any third-party websites.

We are not responsible for any loss, damage, or issues arising from your use of third-party platforms, products, or services accessed through external links on our website. We encourage you to review their respective terms and privacy policies before engaging with them.

14. Changes To These Terms

We may update these Terms of Service from time to time to reflect changes in our services, legal requirements, or business practices. When we do, we will update the "Last updated" date at the top of this page to reflect the latest version.

For active clients, significant changes that materially affect ongoing services or contractual obligations will be communicated directly by email with reasonable notice where applicable. Your continued use of our website or services after changes take effect constitutes your acceptance of those updated Terms.

15. Governing Law

These Terms shall be governed by and interpreted in accordance with the laws applicable to Tanot Solutions' registered place of business, without regard to conflict of law principles. Any disputes arising out of or relating to these Terms or our services shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts relevant to Tanot Solutions' registered jurisdiction.

Before initiating any formal legal proceedings, both parties agree to make reasonable efforts to resolve the matter amicably through good-faith communication and mutual discussion.

16. Questions and Contact

If you have any questions about these Terms of Service, or if you'd like to discuss anything before engaging our services, please reach out — we're happy to provide clarification where needed.
